# Test Data for Acceptance Tests

This `testdata/` directory contains supporting data used for acceptance tests. It includes three main subdirectories:

## Directory Structure

### `ensembles/`
Contains ensembles used in acceptance test scenarios.

### `scripts/`
Holds all scripts referenced by ensembles.  
**Note:** Do not use absolute paths when referencing scripts in ensembles; use only the filename.

### `logs/`
Stores logs generated during test execution, useful for debugging and analyzing test results.
